test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Game Changer’ is the name of an autobiography of which sportsperson?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Shahid Afridi__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shahid Afridi** is Pakistan's cricket team's former captain and star all-rounder.
 
• He recently released his controversial autobiography, '**Game Changer**'.
 
• The book is **co-authored** by Afridi and journalist **Wajahat.S.Khan**.
 
• He retired from all forms of cricket in April 2016 after a 20-year International career. 
 
• In which he appeared in 27 Tests, 398 ODI's, and 99 T20 Internationals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rahul Dravid **is currently the Head Coach of the Men's Indian International Cricket team, known for his sound-batting technique and also known as Mr Dependable.
 
• **Shane Warne **(1964-2022) was an Australian international cricketer, who played as a right-arm leg spinner and right-hand batsman for Victoria, Hampshire, and Australia.
 
• **Yuvraj Singh** is a former Indian international cricketer who played all formats of the game.
 
• **No Spin is the autobiography of Shane Warne**, The **Nice guy who finished first is the Autobiography of Rahul Dravid** and **The test of my life is the autobiography of Yuvraj Singh.**
